{"code":"
seq = open("region.fasta").read().split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","").strip()
L=len(seq)
def rc(s): return s.translate(str.maketrans("ACGT","TGCA"))[::-1]

# ---- reverse-complement symmetry ----
print("palindromic strand equal? ", seq==rc(seq))
best=set(); s=rc(seq)
for i in range(L):
    # longest common stretch starting at i with mismatch tolerance 0
    j=0
    while i+j<L and s[i+j]==seq[i+j]: j+=1
    if j>=50: best.add((i+1,j))
print("longest exact common stretch with RC (>=50):", sorted(best)[-1:] or "none >=50", sorted(best)[:5])

# ---- GC skew in 250bp windows ----
print("\nGC skew (G-C)/(G+C) per 250bp window:")
for w in range(0,L,250):
    sub=seq[w:w+250]
    g=sub.count("G"); c=sub.count("C")
    at=sub.count("A"); t=sub.count("T")
    print(f"  {w+1}-{w+len(sub)}: GC%={(g+c)/len(sub)*100:5.1f}  (G-C)/(G+C)={(g-c)/(g+c) if g+c else 0:+.2f}  (A-T)/(A+T)={(at-t)/(at+t):+.2f}")
"}
